anchors.name: QuasiFeffermanB.LH_ENERGY_BOUNDS
anchors.source_signature:
theorem LH_ENERGY_BOUNDS
    {ν : ℝ} {a : CriticalPhysicalL2} {u : Velocity}
    {G : WeakGradientTrajectory}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hu : CriticalLerayHopf ν a u G) :
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → physicalEnergy (u t) ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2) ∧
    ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun t => criticalGradientEnergy (G t)) volume 0 T ∧
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, criticalGradientEnergy (G t)) ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ν)
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem LH_ENERGY_BOUNDS
    {ν : ℝ} {a : CriticalPhysicalL2} {u : Velocity}
    {G : WeakGradientTrajectory}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hu : CriticalLerayHopf ν a u G) :
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → physicalEnergy (u t) ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2) ∧
    ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun t => criticalGradientEnergy (G t)) volume 0 T ∧
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, criticalGradientEnergy (G t)) ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ν) := by
  constructor
  · intro t ht
    exact hu.velocity_energy_le_initial hν.le ht
  · intro T hT
    refine ⟨hu.dissipation_integrable T hT, ?_⟩
    have hE : 0 ≤ physicalEnergy (u T) := by
      rw [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq]
      exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
    have henergy := hu.energy_initial T hT.le
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * ν)).2
    nlinarith
anchors.use: Pointwise E<=E0 and integrable dissipation with integral Y<=E0/(2nu).
anchors.boundary: Does not establish the sharper weighted integral E*Y<=E0^2/(4nu).

anchors.name: QuasiFeffermanB.criticalFourthPower_budget
anchors.source_signature:
theorem criticalFourthPower_budget
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {m : Measure α}
    {kinetic gradient critical : α → ℝ} {M μ : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hgradient : Integrable gradient m)
    (hcritical : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => critical t ^ 2) m)
    (hpoint : ∀ᵐ t ∂m,
      0 ≤ gradient t ∧ kinetic t ≤ M ∧
      critical t ^ 2 ≤ kinetic t * gradient t)
    (hdissipation : (∫ t, gradient t ∂m) ≤ M / (2 * μ)) :
    (∫ t, critical t ^ 2 ∂m) ≤ M ^ 2 / (2 * μ)
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem criticalFourthPower_budget
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {m : Measure α}
    {kinetic gradient critical : α → ℝ} {M μ : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hgradient : Integrable gradient m)
    (hcritical : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => critical t ^ 2) m)
    (hpoint : ∀ᵐ t ∂m,
      0 ≤ gradient t ∧ kinetic t ≤ M ∧
      critical t ^ 2 ≤ kinetic t * gradient t)
    (hdissipation : (∫ t, gradient t ∂m) ≤ M / (2 * μ)) :
    (∫ t, critical t ^ 2 ∂m) ≤ M ^ 2 / (2 * μ) := by
  have hc := criticalFourthPower_integrable hgradient hcritical hpoint
  have hdom : ∀ᵐ t ∂m, critical t ^ 2 ≤ M * gradient t := by
    filter_upwards [hpoint] with t ht
    exact ht.2.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht.2.1 ht.1)
  calc
    (∫ t, critical t ^ 2 ∂m) ≤ ∫ t, M * gradient t ∂m :=
      integral_mono_ae hc (hgradient.const_mul M) hdom
    _ = M * (∫ t, gradient t ∂m) := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ M * (M / (2 * μ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdissipation hM
    _ = M ^ 2 / (2 * μ) := by ring
anchors.use: Arbitrary measure space, integrable gradient, measurable critical^2, nonnegative gradient, kinetic<=M, critical^2<=kinetic*gradient and integral gradient<=M/(2mu) imply integral critical^2<=M^2/(2mu).
anchors.boundary: Freezes kinetic at M; the denominator is 2mu, not the desired 4nu. Do not relabel it as the weighted-energy theorem.

anchors.name: IntervalIntegrable.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_intervalIntegral
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem _root_.IntervalIntegrable.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_intervalIntegral {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a b c : ℝ} (h : IntervalIntegrable f volume a b) (hc : c ∈ uIcc a b) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (fun x ↦ ∫ v in c..x, f v) a b := by
  -- Step 1: Use `MeasureTheory.tendsto_setLIntegral_zero` to conclude that the function sending
  -- `E` to `∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in s E, ‖f x‖ₑ ∂volume.restrict (uIoc a b))` tends to `0` along
  -- `totalLengthFilter ⊓ 𝓟 (disjWithin a b)`.
  let s := fun E : ℕ × (ℕ → ℝ × ℝ) ↦ ⋃ i ∈ Finset.range E.1, uIoc (E.2 i).1 (E.2 i).2
  have : Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in s i, ‖f x‖ₑ ∂volume.restrict (uIoc a b))
      (totalLengthFilter ⊓ 𝓟 (disjWithin a b)) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_setLIntegral_zero
    (ne_of_lt <| intervalIntegrable_iff.mp h |>.hasFiniteIntegral)
    (tendsto_volume_restrict_totalLengthFilter_disjWithin_nhds_zero _ _)
  -- Step 2: Use the lintegral in Step 1 to bound the sum of the distances between
  -- `∫ v in c..(E.2 i).2, f v` and `∫ v in c..(E.2 i).2, f v` that occurs in the definition
  -- of absolutely continuous.
  have := ENNReal.toReal_zero ▸ (ENNReal.continuousAt_toReal (by simp)).tendsto.comp this
  refine squeeze_zero' ?_ ?_ this
  · filter_upwards with (n, I)
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ ↦ dist_nonneg)
  simp only [comp_apply, s]
  have : ∀ᶠ (E : ℕ × (ℕ → ℝ × ℝ)) in totalLengthFilter ⊓ 𝓟 (disjWithin a b),
      E ∈ disjWithin a b :=
    eventually_inf_principal.mpr (by simp)
  filter_upwards [this] with (n, I) hnI
  obtain ⟨hnI1, hnI2⟩ := mem_ofPred_eq ▸ hnI
  simp only
  rw [← integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm (h.aestronglyMeasurable_restrict_uIoc.restrict),
      integral_biUnion_finset _ (by simp +contextual [uIoc]) hnI2]
  · refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi ↦ ?_)
    rw [Real.dist_eq,
        intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left
          (by apply IntervalIntegrable.mono_set' h; grind [uIoc, uIcc])
          (by apply IntervalIntegrable.mono_set' h; grind [uIoc, uIcc]),
        Measure.restrict_restrict_of_subset
          (uIoc_subset_of_mem_disjWithin hnI (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)),
        intervalIntegral.integral_symm, abs_neg,
        intervalIntegral.abs_intervalIntegral_eq]
    exact abs_integral_le_integral_abs
  · intro i hi
    unfold IntegrableOn
    have h_subset := uIoc_subset_of_mem_disjWithin hnI (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    rw [Measure.restrict_restrict_of_subset h_subset]
    exact IntegrableOn.mono_set h.def'.norm h_subset |>.integrable
anchors.use: An interval-integrable real function has an absolutely continuous primitive from any basepoint in the interval.
anchors.boundary: Supplies AC of F(t)=integral_0^t Y, not by itself the energy majorant comparison.

anchors.name: IntervalIntegrable.ae_hasDerivAt_integral
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem IntervalIntegrable.ae_hasDerivAt_integral {f : ℝ → E} {a b : ℝ}
    (hf : IntervalIntegrable f volume a b) :
    ∀ᵐ x, x ∈ uIcc a b → ∀ c ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ (t : ℝ) in c..x, f t) (f x) x := by
  wlog hab : a ≤ b
  · exact uIcc_comm b a ▸ this hf.symm (by linarith)
  rw [uIcc_of_le hab]
  have h₁ : ∀ᵐ x, x ≠ a := by simp [ae_iff, measure_singleton]
  have h₂ : ∀ᵐ x, x ≠ b := by simp [ae_iff, measure_singleton]
  let g (x : ℝ) := if x ∈ Ioc a b then f x else 0
  have hg : LocallyIntegrable g volume :=
    integrableOn_congr_fun (by grind [EqOn]) (by simp) |>.mpr hf.left
      |>.integrable_of_forall_notMem_eq_zero (by grind) |>.locallyIntegrable
  filter_upwards [LocallyIntegrable.ae_hasDerivAt_integral hg, h₁, h₂] with x hx _ _ _
  intro c hc
  refine HasDerivWithinAt.hasDerivAt (s := Ioo a b) ?_ <|
    Ioo_mem_nhds (by grind) (by grind)
  rw [show f x = g x by grind]
  refine (hx c).hasDerivWithinAt.congr (fun y hy ↦ ?_) ?_
  all_goals apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae' <;> filter_upwards <;> grind
anchors.inherited_context: E is a complete real normed space; f: Real -> E.
anchors.use: For interval-integrable Banach-valued f, primitive derivative equals f almost everywhere in the interval, for all basepoints there.
anchors.boundary: Derivative is only a.e.; this is sufficient with the AC theorem, and does not require continuity of Y.

anchors.name: AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.integral_deriv_mul_eq_sub
anchors.source_signature:
theorem AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.integral_deriv_mul_eq_sub
    {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hf : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f a b) (hg : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval g a b) :
    ∫ x in a..b, deriv f x * g x + f x * deriv g x = f b * g b - f a * g a
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.integral_deriv_mul_eq_sub
    {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hf : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f a b) (hg : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval g a b) :
    ∫ x in a..b, deriv f x * g x + f x * deriv g x = f b * g b - f a * g a := by
  rw [← (hf.fun_mul hg).integral_deriv_eq_sub]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hf.ae_differentiableAt, hg.ae_differentiableAt] with x hx₁ hx₂ hx₃
  have hx₄ : x ∈ uIcc a b := uIoc_subset_uIcc hx₃
  have hx₅ := (hx₁ hx₄).hasDerivAt.mul (hx₂ hx₄).hasDerivAt
  exact hx₅.deriv.symm
anchors.use: For real absolutely continuous f and g, the integral of deriv f*g+f*deriv g is the endpoint product difference.
anchors.boundary: The recovered QFA.Energy.envelope_product_integral implements the AC product route using this declaration; see S07-Q01. This Mathlib dependency itself has no separately collected named audit in the periodic material receipt.

anchors.name: AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hf : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f a b) (hg : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval g a b) :
    ∫ x in a..b, f x * deriv g x = f b * g b - f a * g a - ∫ x in a..b, deriv f x * g x := by
  rw [← AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.integral_deriv_mul_eq_sub hf hg,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub]
  · simp_rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
  · exact (hf.intervalIntegrable_deriv.mul_continuousOn hg.continuousOn).add
      (hg.intervalIntegrable_deriv.continuousOn_mul hf.continuousOn)
  · exact hf.intervalIntegrable_deriv.mul_continuousOn hg.continuousOn
anchors.use: Integration by parts for two real absolutely continuous functions.
anchors.boundary: Alternative to S07-05; requires actual AC hypotheses, not mere continuity or a.e. differentiability alone.

anchors.name: SingularClosure.CRITICAL_SQUARE_BUDGET_DIV
anchors.source_signature:
theorem CRITICAL_SQUARE_BUDGET_DIV
    {A B X d : ℝ → ℝ} {ν C a₀ T : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha₀ : 0 ≤ a₀)
    (hsmall : C * a₀ < ν)
    (hA : ContinuousOn A (Icc 0 T))
    (hX : ContinuousOn X (Icc 0 T))
    (hAnonneg : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ A t)
    (hB : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, 0 ≤ B t)
    (hinit : A 0 ≤ a₀ ^ 2)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt A (d t) (Ici 0) t)
    (hcritical : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T,
      d t + 2 * (ν - C * Real.sqrt (A t)) * B t ≤ 0)
    (hinterp : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, X t ^ 2 ≤ A t * B t) :
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..T, X s ^ 2) ≤
      (a₀ ^ 4 - A T ^ 2) / (4 * (ν - C * a₀))
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem CRITICAL_SQUARE_BUDGET_DIV
    {A B X d : ℝ → ℝ} {ν C a₀ T : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha₀ : 0 ≤ a₀)
    (hsmall : C * a₀ < ν)
    (hA : ContinuousOn A (Icc 0 T))
    (hX : ContinuousOn X (Icc 0 T))
    (hAnonneg : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ A t)
    (hB : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, 0 ≤ B t)
    (hinit : A 0 ≤ a₀ ^ 2)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt A (d t) (Ici 0) t)
    (hcritical : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T,
      d t + 2 * (ν - C * Real.sqrt (A t)) * B t ≤ 0)
    (hinterp : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, X t ^ 2 ≤ A t * B t) :
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..T, X s ^ 2) ≤
      (a₀ ^ 4 - A T ^ 2) / (4 * (ν - C * a₀)) := by
  have h := CRITICAL_SQUARE_BUDGET hT hC ha₀ hsmall hA hX hAnonneg hB hinit
    hderiv hcritical hinterp T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩
  have hA0 := hAnonneg 0 ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩
  have hsq : A 0 ^ 2 ≤ a₀ ^ 4 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a₀ ^ 2 - A 0)]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4) (sub_pos.mpr hsmall))).2
  nlinarith
anchors.use: Generic differential square-budget theorem with terminal remainder and denominator 4*(nu-C*a0).
anchors.boundary: Requires continuous A and X, a derivative at every time in Ico, a pointwise differential inequality and interpolation. These hypotheses are not supplied for a general LH energy path or an L1-dissipation primitive. It is not the requested weighted LH lemma.

anchors.name: QuasiFeffermanB.exists_good_time_of_integral_lt
anchors.source_signature:
theorem exists_good_time_of_integral_lt
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {Good : ℝ → Prop} {T c : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hf : Integrable f (criticalTimeMeasure T))
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ t ∂criticalTimeMeasure T, Good t)
    (hbudget : (∫ t, f t ∂criticalTimeMeasure T) < c * T) :
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t < T ∧ Good t ∧ f t < c
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem exists_good_time_of_integral_lt
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {Good : ℝ → Prop} {T c : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hf : Integrable f (criticalTimeMeasure T))
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ t ∂criticalTimeMeasure T, Good t)
    (hbudget : (∫ t, f t ∂criticalTimeMeasure T) < c * T) :
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t < T ∧ Good t ∧ f t < c := by
  by_contra hnone
  have hlower : ∀ᵐ t ∂criticalTimeMeasure T, c ≤ f t := by
    have htime : ∀ᵐ t ∂criticalTimeMeasure T, t ∈ Ioo 0 T :=
      ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo
    filter_upwards [htime, hgood] with t ht hg
    by_contra hnot
    exact hnone ⟨t, ht.1, ht.2, hg, lt_of_not_ge hnot⟩
  have hcomparison :
      (∫ _ : ℝ, c ∂criticalTimeMeasure T) ≤
        ∫ t, f t ∂criticalTimeMeasure T :=
    integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => hc)) hf hlower
  have hconstant : (∫ _ : ℝ, c ∂criticalTimeMeasure T) = c * T := by
    change (∫ _ : ℝ in Ioo 0 T, c ∂volume) = c * T
    rw [setIntegral_const]
    simp [Measure.real, Real.volume_Ioo, hT.le, mul_comm]
  rw [hconstant] at hcomparison
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hcomparison) hbudget
anchors.inherited_context: criticalTimeMeasure T is volume.restrict (Ioo 0 T), defined in CriticalTimeBudget.lean:20-21.
anchors.use: Arbitrary real f and predicate Good; T>0, c>=0, integrability on Ioo(0,T), a.e. Good, and integral f<c*T imply 0<t<T, Good t and f(t)<c.
anchors.boundary: Set f=E*Y, c=theta and T=tauA after proving the weighted bound and integrability. This theorem selects a witness but does not state the quantitative half-measure lower bound.

anchors.name: MeasureTheory.mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
anchors.source_signature:
theorem mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg {f : α → ℝ} (hf_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f)
    (hf_int : Integrable f μ) (ε : ℝ) : ε * μ.real { x | ε ≤ f x } ≤ ∫ x, f x ∂μ
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg {f : α → ℝ} (hf_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f)
    (hf_int : Integrable f μ) (ε : ℝ) : ε * μ.real { x | ε ≤ f x } ≤ ∫ x, f x ∂μ := by
  rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (μ {x | ε ≤ f x}) with hμ | hμ
  · simpa [measureReal_def, hμ] using integral_nonneg_of_ae hf_nonneg
  · have := Fact.mk hμ
    calc
      ε * μ.real { x | ε ≤ f x } = ∫ _ in {x | ε ≤ f x}, ε ∂μ := by simp [mul_comm]
      _ ≤ ∫ x in {x | ε ≤ f x}, f x ∂μ :=
        integral_mono_ae (integrable_const _) (hf_int.mono_measure μ.restrict_le_self) <|

    (hcut : cutoff a ν < T)

      SingularClosure.CriticalPhysicalH1 (u t) (G t) ∧
      physicalHalfEnergy (u t) < ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi * ν ^ 2) := by
  have hcut' : energyCutoff (‖a‖ ^ 2) ν < T := by

  obtain ⟨hint, hbudget⟩ := LH_FOURTH_POWER_BUDGET hν hu hT

    exists_subcritical_good_time hν hcut' hint hgood' hbudget'

theorem CRITICAL_SMOOTH_NSE_ENERGY_IDENTITY (hν : 0 < ν)

  have hscaled : ContinuousOn

  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun r => physicalDissipation (u r)) (Icc s t) := by

    {s δ : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hδ : s < δ)

    {l : Filter ι} {f : ι → E} {a : E}
    (hinner : Tendsto (fun i => inner ℝ (f i) a) l (𝓝 (‖a‖ ^ 2)))
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ i in l, ‖f i‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2) :

anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem strong_tendsto_of_inner_and_norm_bound
    {ι : Type*} {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {l : Filter ι} {f : ι → E} {a : E}
    (hinner : Tendsto (fun i => inner ℝ (f i) a) l (𝓝 (‖a‖ ^ 2)))
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ i in l, ‖f i‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2) :
    Tendsto f l (𝓝 a) := by
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun i => 2 * ‖a‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ (f i) a)
      l (𝓝 0) := by
    have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ι => 2 * ‖a‖ ^ 2) l (𝓝 (2 * ‖a‖ ^ 2)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds
    have htwo : Tendsto (fun i => 2 * inner ℝ (f i) a)
        l (𝓝 (2 * ‖a‖ ^ 2)) := tendsto_const_nhds.mul hinner
    simpa only [sub_self] using hconst.sub htwo
  have hsq : Tendsto (fun i => ‖f i - a‖ ^ 2) l (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall (fun i => sq_nonneg ‖f i - a‖))
      ?_ hupper
    filter_upwards [hbound] with i hi
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real]
    linarith
  have hsqrt := Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hsq
  have hn : Tendsto (fun i => ‖f i - a‖) l (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_zero]
      using hsqrt
  apply tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mpr
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hn

anchors.boundary: Directly reusable with whole-space L2. A weak-continuity/energy argument must provide its two hypotheses.

    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] {f : ℝ → E} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    {s T : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hf : MemLp f p (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T + s)))) :
    MemLp (timeTranslate s f) p (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
  have hsub : Ioc s (T + s) ⊆ Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T + s) := by
    intro t ht
    exact ⟨hs.trans_lt ht.1, ht.2⟩
  exact (hf.mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono_set volume hsub)).comp_measurePreserving
    (timeTranslate_measurePreserving_Ioc s T)
anchors.use: For any normed additive group and exponent p, an Lp path on Ioc(0,T+s) remains Lp on Ioc(0,T) after nonnegative translation s.
anchors.boundary: No spatial domain assumption; useful for R3 energy and Serrin time classes.

anchors.source_signature:
theorem LH_RESTART_FROM_ENERGY_START
    {ν : ℝ} {a₀ : CriticalPhysicalL2} {v : Velocity}
    {G : ℝ → Vec → (Vec →L[ℝ] Vec)}
    (hv : CriticalLerayHopf ν a₀ v G) (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hE : ∀ r : ℝ, s ≤ r → physicalEnergy (v r) +
      2 * ν * (∫ q in s..r, criticalGradientEnergy (G q)) ≤ physicalEnergy (v s)) :
    CriticalLerayHopf ν (criticalL2Representative (v s))
      (timeTranslate s v) (timeTranslate s G)
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem LH_RESTART_FROM_ENERGY_START
    {ν : ℝ} {a₀ : CriticalPhysicalL2} {v : Velocity}
    {G : ℝ → Vec → (Vec →L[ℝ] Vec)}
    (hv : CriticalLerayHopf ν a₀ v G) (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hE : ∀ r : ℝ, s ≤ r → physicalEnergy (v r) +
      2 * ν * (∫ q in s..r, criticalGradientEnergy (G q)) ≤ physicalEnergy (v s)) :
    CriticalLerayHopf ν (criticalL2Representative (v s))
      (timeTranslate s v) (timeTranslate s G) := by
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := hs
  have hvs := hv.velocity_L2 s hs0
  refine {
    momentum := timeTranslate_integrated_momentum hv.momentum hs0
    velocity_L2 := fun t ht => hv.velocity_L2 (t + s) (add_nonneg ht hs0)
    velocity_energy_class := fun T hT =>
      timeTranslate_memLp_Ioc hs0 (hv.velocity_energy_class (T + s) (by linarith))
    gradient_energy_class := fun T hT =>
      timeTranslate_memLp_Ioc hs0 (hv.gradient_energy_class (T + s) (by linarith))
    initial := ?_
    weak_continuity := ?_
    strong_trace := lh_shifted_strong_trace_of_energy_start hv hν hs hE
    spatial_H1 := ?_
    dissipation_integrable := ?_
    energy_initial := ?_
    energy_intervals := ?_
  }
  · simpa only [timeTranslate, zero_add, criticalL2Representative_eq (v s) hvs]
      using hvs.coeFn_toLp.symm
  · intro φ hφ
    exact (hv.weak_continuity φ hφ).comp
      (continuous_id.add continuous_const).continuousOn
      (fun t ht => add_nonneg ht hs0)
  · intro T hT
    exact timeTranslate_ae_Ioc hs0 (hv.spatial_H1 (T + s) (by linarith))
  · intro T hT
    have hI := (hv.dissipation_integrable (T + s) (by linarith)).mono_set
      (show uIcc s (T + s) ⊆ uIcc (0 : ℝ) (T + s) by
        rw [uIcc_of_le (by linarith : s ≤ T + s),
          uIcc_of_le (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T + s)]
        exact Icc_subset_Icc hs0 le_rfl)
    simpa only [sub_self, add_sub_cancel_right, timeTranslate]
      using hI.comp_add_right s
  · intro t ht
    change physicalEnergy (v (t + s)) +
      2 * ν * (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G (r + s))) ≤ _
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right
        (fun r => criticalGradientEnergy (G r)) s, zero_add,
      restart_representative_norm_sq (v s) hvs]
    exact hE (t + s) (by linarith)
  · intro T hT
    have hE := timeTranslate_ae_Ioc hs0
      (hv.energy_intervals (T + s) (by linarith))
    filter_upwards [hE] with r hr
    intro t ht
    change physicalEnergy (v (t + s)) +
      2 * ν * (∫ q in r..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G (q + s))) ≤
        physicalEnergy (v (r + s))
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right
      (fun q => criticalGradientEnergy (G q)) s]
    have hleft : r + s ≤ t + s := by linarith only [ht.1]
    have hright : t + s ≤ T + s := by linarith only [ht.2]
    exact hr (t + s) ⟨hleft, hright⟩
anchors.use: A periodic LH path plus an energy inequality from a specified nonnegative start gives translated LH membership at its exact trace.
anchors.boundary: Reconstructs momentum, energy spaces, weak/strong trace and interval energy fields; R3 must prove those actual translated properties.

theorem LH_RESTART_OF_TAIL_ENERGY
    {ν : ℝ} {a : CriticalPhysicalL2} {u : Velocity} {G : WeakGradientTrajectory}
    (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (hu : CriticalLerayHopf ν a u G)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hE : TailEnergyEquality ν u G δ) :
    CriticalLerayHopf ν (criticalL2Representative (u δ))
      (Shift δ u) (fun t => G (δ + t))
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem LH_RESTART_OF_TAIL_ENERGY
    {ν : ℝ} {a : CriticalPhysicalL2} {u : Velocity} {G : WeakGradientTrajectory}
    (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (hu : CriticalLerayHopf ν a u G)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hE : TailEnergyEquality ν u G δ) :
    CriticalLerayHopf ν (criticalL2Representative (u δ))
      (Shift δ u) (fun t => G (δ + t)) := by
  have hvelocity : timeTranslate δ u = Shift δ u := by
    funext t
    change u (t + δ) = u (δ + t)
    exact congrArg u (add_comm t δ)
  have hgradient : timeTranslate δ G = (fun t => G (δ + t)) := by
    funext t
    change G (t + δ) = G (δ + t)
    exact congrArg G (add_comm t δ)
  have hrestart :=
    LH_RESTART_FROM_ENERGY_START hu hν hδ (fun t ht => (hE t ht).le)
  rw [hvelocity, hgradient] at hrestart
  exact hrestart
anchors.use: A tail energy equality at delta>=0 gives translated LH membership from u(delta).
anchors.boundary: Does not demand H1 correctness of the arbitrary weak-gradient representative at delta; requires the actual R3 analogue of restart.

theorem LH_UNIQUE_FUTURE_OF_REFERENCE_SHIFT_SERRIN
    {ν : ℝ} {a : CriticalPhysicalL2} {u : Velocity} {G : WeakGradientTrajectory}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hu : CriticalLerayHopf ν a u G)
    {v : Velocity} {p : Pressure} (hv : PositiveSmoothNSE ν v p)
    {s δ : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hδ : s < δ)
    (heq : ∀ r : ℝ, s < r →
      u r =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] v (r - s))
    (hSerrin : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T →
      MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (timeTranslate (δ - s) v t)) 4
        (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T))) :
    UniqueFuture ν u G δ
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem LH_UNIQUE_FUTURE_OF_REFERENCE_SHIFT_SERRIN
    {ν : ℝ} {a : CriticalPhysicalL2} {u : Velocity} {G : WeakGradientTrajectory}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hu : CriticalLerayHopf ν a u G)
    {v : Velocity} {p : Pressure} (hv : PositiveSmoothNSE ν v p)
    {s δ : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hδ : s < δ)
    (heq : ∀ r : ℝ, s < r →
      u r =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] v (r - s))
    (hSerrin : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T →
      MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (timeTranslate (δ - s) v t)) 4
        (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T))) :
    UniqueFuture ν u G δ := by
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ := hs.trans hδ.le
  have henergy : TailEnergyEquality ν u G δ :=
    LH_TAIL_ENERGY_OF_POSITIVE_REFERENCE hν hu hv hs hδ heq
  have hrestart := LH_RESTART_OF_TAIL_ENERGY hν.le hu hδ0 henergy
  let ε : ℝ := δ - s
  have hε : 0 < ε := sub_pos.mpr hδ
  have hshift : PositiveSmoothNSE ν (timeTranslate ε v) (timeTranslate ε p) :=
    positiveSmoothNSE_timeTranslate hv hε.le
  have hagree (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
      Shift δ u t =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] timeTranslate ε v t := by
    have h := heq (δ + t) (by linarith)
    have he : δ + t - s = t + ε := by dsimp [ε]; ring
    simpa only [Shift, timeTranslate, he] using h
  have htrace : Tendsto (fun t => eLpNorm
      (timeTranslate ε v t - (criticalL2Representative (u δ) : Field))
      2 (volume.restrict unitCube)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) := by
    apply hrestart.strong_trace.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
    apply eLpNorm_congr_ae
    exact (hagree t ht).sub Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl
  refine ⟨hrestart, ?_⟩
  intro w H hw
  intro t ht
  by_cases hpos : 0 < t
  · have hcomparison := CRITICAL_LERAY_HOPF_SERRIN_COMPARISON_ON
      ν hν (criticalL2Representative (u δ)) w (timeTranslate ε v) H
      (timeTranslate ε p) hw (positiveSmoothNSE_test hshift)
      (fun r hr => positiveSmoothNSE_pressure_spatial_smooth hshift hr)
      hshift.pressure_periodic hshift.equation htrace t hpos
      (hSerrin t hpos)
    exact (hcomparison t ⟨hpos, le_rfl⟩).trans (hagree t hpos).symm
  · have htzero : t = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) ht
    subst t
    exact hw.initial.trans hrestart.initial.symm
anchors.use: Periodic LH path identified with a positive smooth reference after s, s<delta, and a finite-horizon shifted L4_t L6_x Serrin condition imply UniqueFuture.
anchors.boundary: Explicit Serrin variant is the more transparent port target: R3 must derive this norm control from its actual H1 strong tail and whole-space Sobolev, then supply whole-space weak-strong comparison.

theorem positive_reference_strict_shift_serrin
    {ν : ℝ} {v : Velocity} {p : Pressure}
    (hv : PositiveSmoothNSE ν v p) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (T : ℝ) :
    MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (timeTranslate ε v t)) 4
      (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
  have htest := positiveSmoothNSE_test hv
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (timeTranslate ε v t))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply (htest.eLpNorm_six_toReal_continuousOn (T + ε)).comp
      (continuous_id.add continuous_const).continuousOn
    intro t ht
    change 0 < t + ε ∧ t + ε ≤ T + ε
    constructor
    · linarith only [hε, ht.1]
    · linarith only [ht.2]
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)) :=
    ⟨by simp only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Real.volume_Icc]; finiteness⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc
  have hmem : MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (timeTranslate ε v t)) 4
      (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
    apply MemLp.of_bound
      (hc.aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact isCompact_Icc measurableSet_Icc) C
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
    exact hC t ht
  exact hmem.mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono_set volume Ioc_subset_Icc_self)
anchors.use: A strictly positive shift of PositiveSmoothNSE is in finite-horizon L4_t L6_x.
anchors.boundary: Proof uses continuity of the periodic spatial L6 norm and compactness. Pointwise smoothness alone on noncompact R3 does not supply the same conclusion.

theorem envelope_product_integral
    {M ν R : ℝ} {D : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hν : ν ≠ 0)
    (hD : IntervalIntegrable D volume (0 : ℝ) R) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, envelope M ν D t * D t) =
      (M ^ 4 - (envelope M ν D R) ^ 2) / (4 * ν)
anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem envelope_product_integral
    {M ν R : ℝ} {D : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hν : ν ≠ 0)
    (hD : IntervalIntegrable D volume (0 : ℝ) R) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, envelope M ν D t * D t) =
      (M ^ 4 - (envelope M ν D R) ^ 2) / (4 * ν) := by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := envelope M ν D
  change (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, F t * D t) =
    (M ^ 4 - (F R) ^ 2) / (4 * ν)
  have hF : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval F 0 R :=
    envelope_absolutelyContinuousOnInterval (M := M) (ν := ν) hD
  have hF0 : F 0 = M ^ 2 := by
    simp [F]
  -- EP024: AC product FTC with both factors equal to F.
  have hFTC :=
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.integral_deriv_mul_eq_sub hF hF
  have hderiv := envelope_hasDerivAt_ae (M := M) (ν := ν) hD
  have hrewrite :
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, deriv F t * F t + F t * deriv F t) =
        -(4 * ν) * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, F t * D t) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..R, -(4 * ν) * (F t * D t) := by
        -- EP025: replace the derivatives a.e., including the null endpoints.
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hderiv] with t ht
        intro htmem
        -- EP020: HasDerivAt determines the value of deriv.
        have hdt : deriv F t = -(2 * ν * D t) :=
          (ht (uIoc_subset_uIcc htmem)).deriv
        rw [hdt]
        ring
      _ = _ := intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _
  rw [hrewrite, hF0] at hFTC
  apply (eq_div_iff (show 4 * ν ≠ 0 from
    mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hν)).2
  nlinarith only [hFTC]
anchors.use: For interval-integrable D and nonzero nu, proves integral envelope*D=(M^4-envelope(R)^2)/(4nu) by AC product FTC and a.e. derivative substitution.
anchors.boundary: No PDE hypothesis and no derivative/continuity assumption on the weak energy E; this is the actual implemented identity.

    (hT : 0 < T) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hf : Integrable f (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)))
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T), Good t)

theorem exists_good_time_of_integral_lt
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {Good : ℝ → Prop} {T c : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hf : Integrable f (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)))
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T), Good t)
    (hbudget : (∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, f t) < c * T) :
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t < T ∧ Good t ∧ f t < c := by
  -- EP028 source body: absence of a good witness forces an a.e. lower bound.
  by_contra hnone
  have hlower : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T), c ≤ f t := by
    have htime : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T), t ∈ Ioo 0 T :=
      ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo
    filter_upwards [htime, hgood] with t ht hg
    by_contra hnot
    exact hnone ⟨t, ht.1, ht.2, hg, lt_of_not_ge hnot⟩
  -- EP028 source body: integral monotonicity needs the retained integrability.
  -- Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/Bochner/Basic.lean: integral_mono_of_nonneg.
  have hcomparison :
      (∫ _ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, c) ≤
        ∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, f t :=
    integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => hc)) hf hlower
  -- EP028 source body: setIntegral_const and Real.volume_Ioo evaluate the
  -- Lebesgue integral of the threshold on the actual interval.
  have hconstant : (∫ _ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, c) = c * T := by
    rw [setIntegral_const]
    simp [Measure.real, Real.volume_Ioo, hT.le, mul_comm]
  rw [hconstant] at hcomparison
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hcomparison) hbudget

anchors.boundary: Use with current theta,tauA after the nonzero branch. This conclusion selects a witness, not the quantitative half-measure set.

      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ)))
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ), Good t)
    (hbudget : (∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, E t * D t) ≤ M ^ 4 / (4 * ν)) :

    (hprod : Integrable (fun t => E t * D t)
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ)))
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ), Good t)
    (hbudget : (∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, E t * D t) ≤ M ^ 4 / (4 * ν)) :
    ∃ s, 0 < s ∧ s < δ ∧ Good s ∧ E s * D s < 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 4 := by
  have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_of_le_of_lt (qfa_cutoff_nonneg M hν) hcut
  -- D05.01: retain the strict inequality obtained from the frozen cutoff.
  have hstrict : (∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, E t * D t) <
      (4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 4) * δ :=
    hbudget.trans_lt (qfa_budget_lt_threshold hν hcut)
  -- EP028 / D05.02, with f=E*D, c=4*pi^2*nu^4, T=delta, Good unchanged.
  exact exists_good_time_of_integral_lt
    (f := fun t => E t * D t) (Good := Good) (T := δ)
    (c := 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 4)
    hδ (by positivity) hprod hgood hstrict

    (hweak : ∀ b : QFA.Representation.RealSpatialL2,
      ContinuousOn (fun t => inner ℝ (u t) b) (Ici (0 : ℝ)))
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ),
      Good s ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, s ≤ r →
        QFA.Representation.velocityEnergy (u r) +
          2 * ν * (∫ q in s..r, QFA.Representation.gradientEnergy (G q)) ≤
            QFA.Representation.velocityEnergy (u s)) :
    ∃ s, 0 < s ∧ s < δ ∧ Good s ∧
      QFA.Representation.velocityEnergy (u s) *
        QFA.Representation.gradientEnergy (G s) < 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 4 ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, s ≤ r →
        QFA.Representation.velocityEnergy (u r) +
          2 * ν * (∫ q in s..r, QFA.Representation.gradientEnergy (G q)) ≤
            QFA.Representation.velocityEnergy (u s)) ∧
      Tendsto u (𝓝[>] s) (𝓝 (u s)) ∧
      Tendsto (QFA.Endpoints.Restart.timeTranslate s u)
        (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (u s)) := by
  -- D02.05, D04 and D05.02: all profile-to-scalar adapters are explicit.
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hsδ, hgs, hsmall⟩ :=
    h.exists_subcritical_good_time hν hcut hgood
  have hE : ∀ r : ℝ, s ≤ r →
      ‖u r‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ν *
        (∫ q in s..r, QFA.Representation.gradientEnergy (G q)) ≤ ‖u s‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [QFA.Representation.velocityEnergy] using hgs.2
  have hD : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r →
      0 ≤ QFA.Representation.gradientEnergy (G r) :=
    fun r _ => QFA.Representation.gradientEnergy_nonneg (G r)
  -- D05.03 / EP029-EP030: weak pairing continuity plus energy gives strong trace.
  have htrace := QFA.Endpoints.Restart.strong_right_trace_of_energy_start
    hν.le hs0.le hD (hweak (u s)) hE

theorem energyProfile_timeTranslate
    {ν s : ℝ} {a : RealSpatialL2}
    {u : ℝ → RealSpatialL2} {G : ℝ → Fin 3 → RealSpatialL2}
    (h : EnergyProfile ν a u G) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hstart : EnergyStart ν u G s) :
    EnergyProfile ν (u s) (timeTranslate s u) (gradientTranslate s G) := by
  constructor
  · intro R hR
    have hRs : 0 < R + s := lt_of_lt_of_le hR (le_add_of_nonneg_right hs)
    exact timeTranslate_aestronglyMeasurable_Ioo hs
      (h.velocity_aestronglyMeasurable (R + s) hRs)
  · intro R hR j
    have hRs : 0 < R + s := lt_of_lt_of_le hR (le_add_of_nonneg_right hs)
    change MemLp (timeTranslate s (fun t : ℝ => G t j)) 2
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R))
    exact timeTranslate_memLp_Ioo hs (h.gradient_memLp (R + s) hRs j)
  · -- LE068: no positivity of viscosity is required for the translation itself.
    have hshift := timeTranslate_energy_from_start
      (E := fun t => velocityEnergy (u t))
      (D := fun t => gradientEnergy (G t)) (ν := ν) (s := s) hstart
    simpa only [gradientTranslate, timeTranslate] using hshift
anchors.use: An EnergyProfile and nonnegative valid energy start yield the translated EnergyProfile at datum u(s).
anchors.boundary: Profile has no weak-gradient relation, divergence or momentum field; those are still required for actual LH restart.

anchors.source_excerpt:
theorem restartData_of_energyStart
    {ν s : ℝ} {a : RealSpatialL2}
    {u : ℝ → RealSpatialL2} {G : ℝ → Fin 3 → RealSpatialL2}
    (h : EnergyProfile ν a u G) (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hweak : ∀ b : RealSpatialL2,
      ContinuousOn (fun t => inner ℝ (u t) b) (Ici (0 : ℝ)))
    (hstart : EnergyStart ν u G s) :
    RestartData ν u G s := by
  refine ⟨energyProfile_timeTranslate h hs hstart,
    timeTranslate_weakPairingContinuousOn hs hweak, ?_⟩
  have hE : ∀ r : ℝ, s ≤ r →
      ‖u r‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ν * (∫ q in s..r, gradientEnergy (G q)) ≤ ‖u s‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [EnergyStart, velocityEnergy] using hstart
  -- LE072: all dissipation values are squared-norm sums and hence nonnegative.
  exact shifted_strong_trace_of_energy_start hν hs
    (fun r _ => gradientEnergy_nonneg (G r)) (hweak (u s)) hE
anchors.use: Combines translated profile, weak pairing continuity and strong initial trace into RestartData.
anchors.boundary: RestartData has exactly these three fields and is not physical solution-class membership.

    (hg_integrable : IntervalIntegrable g volume (0 : ℝ) T)

    (hgood : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T), Good s)

    (hv_trace : Tendsto v (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 a₀))

theorem ComparableOnNonnegative.eq_on_tail
    {u v : ℝ → V} {a₀ : V} {s : ℝ}

theorem ComparableOnNonnegative.eq_on_tail
    {u v : ℝ → V} {a₀ : V} {s : ℝ}
    (h : ComparableOnNonnegative (timeTranslate s u) v a₀) :
    ∀ t : ℝ, s ≤ t → u t = v (t - s) := by
  intro t ht
  have heq := h.eq_on_nonnegative (t - s) (sub_nonneg.mpr ht)
  change u ((t - s) + s) = v (t - s) at heq
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at heq
  exact heq

    (hSpectral : WholeSpaceSpectralEndpoint)
    (hAgmon : WholeSpaceAgmonEndpoint)
    (hReferenceBackend :

    ∀ a ∈ Domain,
      (Admissible a).Nonempty ∧
      ∀ u ∈ Admissible a,
        u 0 = a ∧ Tendsto u (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 a) ∧
        ∀ δ : ℝ, ‖a‖ ^ 4 / (16 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 5) < δ →

            EnergyProfile ν a u G ∧
              Chain.SelectedTail ν δ Admissible Reference u G (Good u G)

theorem selectedTail_smooth
    {ν δ : ℝ}
    {Admissible : RealSpatialL2 → Set Trajectory}
    {Reference : RealSpatialL2 → Trajectory → Prop}
    {SmoothNSETail : ℝ → Trajectory → ℝ → Prop}
    {u : Trajectory} {G : GradientTrajectory} {Good : ℝ → Prop}
    (h : SelectedTail ν δ Admissible Reference u G Good)
    (hSmooth : SmoothReferencePorts ν Reference SmoothNSETail) :
    SmoothNSETail ν u δ := by
  obtain ⟨s, v, hs0, hsδ, hgood, hsmall, hstart, hrestart,
    href, htail, hrefδ, hadmitδ, hrestricted, hsingleton⟩ := h
  have hv : SmoothNSETail ν v (δ - s) :=
    hSmooth.positive_time href (δ - s) (sub_pos.mpr hsδ)
  have hu : SmoothNSETail ν u (s + (δ - s)) :=
    hSmooth.transport htail hv
  have hsum : s + (δ - s) = δ := by ring
  simpa only [hsum] using hu

    {ν : ℝ}

    {Reference : RealSpatialL2 → Trajectory → Prop}
    {Good : Trajectory → GradientTrajectory → ℝ → Prop}
    {SmoothNSETail : ℝ → Trajectory → ℝ → Prop}
    (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hClass : ClassRealization ν Domain Admissible Good)
    (hPorts : ReferencePorts Admissible Reference)
    (hSpectral : QFA.Endpoints.Agmon.WholeSpaceSpectralEndpoint)
    (hAgmon : QFA.Endpoints.Agmon.WholeSpaceAgmonEndpoint)
    (hReferenceBackend :
      CorrectedReferenceConstructionFromAbsorption
        ν Domain Admissible Reference Good)
    (hSmooth : SmoothReferencePorts ν Reference SmoothNSETail) :
    QFARoot ν Domain Admissible SmoothNSETail := by
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨hNonempty, hAll⟩ :=
    quantified_tail_assembly_of_corrected_analytic_inputs
      hν hClass hPorts hSpectral hAgmon hReferenceBackend a ha
  refine ⟨hNonempty, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨hInitial, hTrace, hTails⟩ := hAll u hu
  refine ⟨hTrace, ?_⟩
  intro δ hcut
  obtain ⟨G, hProfile, hSelected⟩ := hTails δ hcut
  exact selectedTail_root_conclusion hSelected hSmooth
